thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired — inference-eu-high-latency (P1)
pagerduty-bot: Alert: inference-service-eu: 95th latency > 2.5s and 5xx spike across seq-processing. Triggered by threshold-policy: eu-latency-rapid. Link: https://pd.example/INC-3456

maria: ACK — i'm oncall and grabbing dashboards now :eyes:

ops-bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.example/incident-3456 — join for voice if needed

jun: +1, i'm online and can help with scaling and routing. any immediate customer reports?

maria: seeing elevated 502/504 from the frontend -> inference proxy. Service CPU on GPUs in eu-west saturated, queue depth climbing. A few pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Past 3m: 8% 5xx, current q depth 4k.

maria: quick dump of recent kube events and container OOM hints:
```
2026-03-15T08:02:01Z inference-proxy-7f8b: WARN request_timeout 1.2s
2026-03-15T08:02:05Z worker-eu-0 OOMKilled
2026-03-15T08:02:07Z worker-eu-1 Restarted container
2026-03-15T08:03:12Z autoscaler scale up desired=6->10
```

devon: i can flip routing to the us fallback pool if we need fast relief. that will add cross-region RTT but reduce 5xx. want me to cut over?

maria: yes please, start a controlled traffic reroute to us-east for non-EU customers. keep EU pinned for customers with data residency. devon: confirm which routes to shift?

devon: shifting /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/chat for the default tenant group to us-east. not touching enterprise-*/eu-only routes. applying rate-limit to 500r/s as safety.

sylvia: i can take the ownership after initial stabilization (30m). maria, keep me posted, i'll prepare runbook for rollback and postmortem notes.

maria: plan: 1) devon start routing shift (in progress) 2) jun coordinate autoscaler and check kernel mem tuning, 3) restart crashloop pods after investigating OOM root cause 4) sylvia take ownership after 30m for long tail and customer comms.

jun: autoscaler shows scaled to 12 workers already. i'm increasing pod memory limit on a suspect worker type from 8Gi -> 12Gi to stop immediate OOMs. applying now: `kubectl patch deployment worker-eu --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"12Gi"}}}]}}}}'`

maria: copy. i'm watching logs for error patterns. also seeing repeated KV-cache warm misses, prefix cache thrash. could be request storm with long contexts. adding temporary prefix-cache TTL increase.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded — incident assigned to maria (primary) and sylvia (handoff pending).

devon: routing change is 40% complete for targeted routes, 5xx on EU has dropped to 2% now. queue depth down to 1.1k.

maria: nice. initiating controlled restarts for the three crashloop pods — rolling restart with 60s delay.

jun: after mem bump and restarts we're seeing stable pods. latency 95th trending down to ~1.1s for eu-local traffic. still some tail but much improved.

maria: customer impact: intermittent failures for ~5% of EU orgs over past 12m, degraded latency for all EU requests during spike window. Logged customers who reported errors: acme-corp, homely-app (internal ticket numbers created).

sylvia: i'm taking over primary ownership now for ongoing validation and comms. maria — handing off, thanks. :handshake:

maria: handing off to sylvia. remaining tasks for you: validate synthetic canaries, drive postmortem, and coordinate customer messages. i'll stick around for another 10m if needed.

sylvia: acked. i'll run the canary suite and draft an initial blurb for customer success. also will schedule a follow-up RCA session.

devon: routing rollback queued — will revert traffic shift once canaries green, ETA ~15m.

maria: final note: root cause likely multi-factor: transient request storm + cache misses + slightly too-aggressive memory limits for the worker flavor. we mitigated by scaling, mem bump, and routing fallback.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: incident updated to status: under_control — assigned to sylvia.

sylvia: can everyone add any additional context to the incident doc: https://docs.example/incidents/3456 before I publish a summary? I'll include timeline, mitigation steps, and customer impact.

jun: added autoscaler logs and patch diff.

devon: added routing diff and canary screenshots.

maria: added initial carousel of logs and affected org list.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved by sylvia — resolution note: routing fallback + scaling + memory bump stabilized latency and reduced 5xx. Follow-up: RCA scheduled.

sylvia: resolving here as well. thanks team. :thumbsup:
